subject.title: feat: add disableBoundaryAwareCache compat option for prefix-matching prompt cache providers

question: Should OpenClaw make the DeepSeek fix an auto-enabled public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` contract, or require a config-free message-shaping rule instead?
rationale: Both approaches change provider-visible prompt ordering, but this PR adds a durable config/API surface and upgrade default; repository policy requires owner intent rather than inferring that permanent contract from successful tests alone.

options.title: Adopt the DeepSeek compat contract
options.body: Accept the DeepSeek-only auto-default with explicit `false` opt-out after the trailing carrier is sanitized and the conflicted branch is refreshed.

options.title: Require a config-free rule
options.body: Pause this PR and select a production-path, live-proven replacement that avoids adding a new public compatibility field.

recommendation.title: Adopt the DeepSeek compat contract
recommendation.body: Accept the DeepSeek-only auto-default with explicit `false` opt-out after the trailing carrier is sanitized and the conflicted branch is refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history spans the provider cache-boundary behavior, OpenAI-completions compatibility, and exported compat type surface involved in this choice.
